text: The proposed update would change the cache lifetime from its current setting of five minutes to a proposed setting of fifteen minutes. In the twenty-four-hour benchmark, the change was associated with eighteen percent fewer requests reaching the origin, a reduction that is operationally promising. That positive result must be weighed against an exact evidence boundary: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. I therefore recommend approving only a canary deployment and requiring stale-read telemetry before considering any broader rollout. The evidence supports a limited experiment, but it does not support broad rollout.
